entities.summary: Park Ye-eun (b. 1989-05-26, Goyang) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Goyang and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
